warnings: All views on this sheet are member details of one pattern (section) — kept in one file like the S-05 files of houses 93/151 (no id collision except the intended mid-span / support pairs of B1 and B2, told apart by section_ref).

F1: one spread footing type for all 15 points, 1.00 x 1.00 x 0.25 on soil (no piles), top 1.00 below ระดับดินเดิม, mat 6+6-DB12 (main_bar.count is the two-way total, section 6b) and one RB 9 รัดรอบ edge tie (count 1, no spacing). The two 0.05 layers below it carry no label on the F1 detail — recorded as lean concrete over sand by their drawn hatch, mix left null (the 1:3:5 label is printed only on the GS detail).

B1 and B2 are both 0.20 x 0.40 with ป.1RB6@0.20 m.; they differ only in the extra bars (ส.พ.ศ. 1-DB12 vs 2-DB12) — bottom at mid-span, top at the support. The drawn dot counts agree with the callouts (B1 mid-span 2 top / 3 bottom, B1 support 3 / 2, B2 mid-span 2 / 4, B2 support 4 / 2).

C1 = 0.20 x 0.20, 4-DB12, ป.1RB6@0.15 m. GS: 0.10 slab with one mesh RB9@0.20m# on 0.05 lean concrete 1:3:5 and compacted sand (sand thickness not printed). S1 prints a short-span and a long-span section with the same reinforcement — merged to one entry; top bars over supports in additional_bars, bottom mesh is main_bar.

Notes conflict, decided (see the A-01 notes file): A-01 specifies SR24 (2,400 ksc) for footing-column-beam steel, but this sheet prints DB12 main bars in F1, B1, B2 and C1 — member spec follows this detail sheet (detail beats general note); stirrups/ties RB6/RB9 match the notes' round bar.
